page.layout: One title page: centred title lines above a woodcut tree engraving, imprint lines below.
page.l: S. Theologiæ Doct. Pastore, & Professore, in
page.notes: Woodcut engraving between the title lines and the imprint: a tree with a serpent coiled around its trunk, a banner in its branches reading "...LIGNO ... FRUCTU" (partly illegible, the letters are too small and worn to read with certainty), and a figure with a spear at the right. Faint show-through of text from the reverse side is visible (e.g. "D. EDUARDO RAYNOLDO"), not transcribed. A handwritten mark (a small "S") sits at the upper left of CONFUTATI, not transcribed. The date is printed as cIↄ Iↄ c lxii, rendered as MDCLXII.
